title: Magnus Plays Unicorn Attack!!! 🦄
transcript: Queen takes E3 is a majestic sacrifice that gives up the queen completely, but why should you care? Well, look at who is playing with the white pieces. It is Magnus Carlsen, the strongest player ever. But, to understand why I'm showing you this game, we have to take it all the way back to the first move. Magnus started with A3, not fighting for the center, and then pushed H3 on the other side, a very unusual opening choice. But, what's more spectacular is what he did just a few moves later. After black took some of the center and developed some of his pieces, Magnus here decided to play knight A2. Does this maneuver look familiar to you? Well, wait until you see the next move. Magnus played knight H2 and he officially entered a textbook unicorn attack. This is my invention. This is the opening that I created just a few weeks ago, and now the goat is playing it in an online game on Tech Deck Deck. If you had told me 4 years ago when I started playing chess that one day the goat would have played my invention, I would have just not believed you. But anyway, the game kept going and this is a real online rated game that Magnus played in the unicorn attack. But, if you want to see the full game and how actually Magnus made a comeback after the brilliant sacrifice of his opponent, you can find the full video on my channel.
